text: No fire was detected on the asset during the evaluated period (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-25). The analysis covered the asset using multiple sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS) from NASA FIRMS, which track active fires and thermal anomalies. While the sensors provided near-daily coverage, no detections intersected the asset. The last day (2026-10-25) had partial coverage due to near-real-time data delays, but even then, no fire activity was recorded. The conclusion is clear: no fire occurred on the asset during this period.
